_catatan: Mini-game simulator lapangan. mech: hold | timing | targets | catch. zone = rentang 0..1 yang dihitung "Tepat". at = posisi titik tugas di peta mini blok (0..1). hk_delegate = HK bila ditugaskan ke tim (dibagi speed profil). bg = latar belakang minigame. requires = syarat aktif: none | land_or_nursery | tm | nursery. deny_msg = prompt saat syarat tak terpenuhi. reward_eligible = ikut hitungan bonus 7 minigame. Bintang: hold/timing -> hits/rounds >=0.8 => 3, >=0.5 => 2, else 1; targets -> akurasi (hits-misses)/valid >=0.99 & <25 dtk => 3, >=0.6 => 2, else 1; catch -> akurasi tangkapan. Tim = selalu 2 bintang.
